prompt_text:
ONE CONTINUOUS ANCIENT WALL FRESCO. Entire frame is cracked aged lime plaster, hand-painted with worn ochre, iron red, soot black, terre verte and faded blue mineral pigment; visible abrasion, stains, cracks and imperfect flat brushwork.
FOCUS: OBJECT_RITUAL. SUBJECT: the source-established object painted directly into an ancient wall scene, surrounded by source-supported symbolic context. ACTION: the object is shown in the exact functional or ritual relationship described by the source. PEOPLE: only if explicit person-role evidence exists.
DETAILS: irregular painted borders; small contextual side scenes only when source-supported. SYMBOLS: the source-established object; weathered symbolic border. MEANING: hash integrity is not evidence that the measurement itself was correct; Write canonical JANUS-compatible JSON records directly; append safely as JSONL NDJSON on embedded storage, then seal compact into ordinary JSON….
COMPOSITION: never a catalog or product shot; object remains fused to the plaster field; one continuous mural field. No grid, tiles, repeated medallions, icon sheet, contact sheet, specimen board, white background or equal cells. Everything shares one plaster field. System labels never become people or gods. Uncertain claims stay uncertain. No diagram, infographic, CAD, UI, product shot, glossy machine, readable code, JSON or modern labels.
